items.summary: The base PS5 is getting an optimized version of Sony's AI-powered upscaling technology, offering developers a new way to improve image quality and stability without demanding more powerful hardware.

items.title_en: Sony brings AI-powered upscaling to the standard PS5

items.title_bilingual: 索尼为标准 PS5 带来人工智能驱动的升级 / Sony brings AI-powered upscaling to the standard PS5

items.title: Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items.summary: Amazon and chip design tool maker Synopsys have inked a multi-year partnership worth over a billion dollars. As part of the arrangement, Amazon will license Synopsys' chip designs and its design tools to create and optimize new AI chips. Synopsys will adopt Amazon Bedrock to build and deploy AI agents, and adopt AWS computing and storage services, while optimizing its own tools for Amazon hardware.
items.title_original: Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items.title_en: Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items.title_zh: 亚马逊和 Synopsys 签署了价值数十亿美元的多年 IP 协议，以加速人工智能芯片设计工作
items.title_bilingual: 亚马逊和 Synopsys 签署了价值数十亿美元的多年 IP 协议，以加速人工智能芯片设计工作 / Amazon and Synopsys ink multi-year billion-dollar deal in multi-year IP agreement to accelerate AI chip design efforts
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊和芯片设计工具制造商 Synopsys 签署了价值超过 10 亿美元的多年合作伙伴关系。作为协议的一部分，亚马逊将授权新思科技的芯片设计及其设计工具来创建和优化新的人工智能芯片。 Synopsys将采用Amazon Bedrock来构建和部署AI代理，并采用AWS计算和存储服务，同时针对亚马逊硬件优化自己的工具。

items.title: Nvidia introduces 64GB DGX Spark to throw local AI fans a lifeline amid the RAMpocalypse
items.summary: Nvidia is introducing a 64GB version of its DGX Spark local AI workstation that's tailored for a new generation of highly intelligent yet compact local models. Starting at $4999, the more affordable configuration is otherwise identical to the original 128GB Spark and its GB10 siblings.

items.title_en: Nvidia introduces 64GB DGX Spark to throw local AI fans a lifeline amid the RAMpocalypse

items.title_bilingual: Nvidia 推出 64GB DGX Spark，为当地 AI 粉丝提供 RAM 末日的救命稻草 / Nvidia introduces 64GB DGX Spark to throw local AI fans a lifeline amid the RAMpocalypse
items.summary_zh: Nvidia 推出了 64GB 版本的 DGX Spark 本地 AI 工作站，该工作站专为新一代高度智能且紧凑的本地模型量身定制。起价 4999 美元，更实惠的配置在其他方面与原始 128GB Spark 及其 GB10 兄弟产品相同。
